Anointed Samoan family faction built around Roman Reigns.

How The Bloodline connects

  • Character: Roman Reigns — Roman Reigns leads The Bloodline as Tribal Chief.
  • Topic: WWE — The Bloodline is the defining WWE faction of the 2020s.

What is The Bloodline?

The Bloodline — Roman Reigns, Paul Heyman, and Usos/Solo chapters — was the 2020s faction that controlled the Undisputed Championship picture and weekly SmackDown lore.

Key threads lead to Roman Reigns and WWE.
